verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm docs describe a full GPU-compute toolchain (HIP runtime, compilers, libraries, profiling and debugging tools) that is optimized for AMD Instinct. The Instinct docs portal pairs HIP C++ and OpenMP programming guides with Instinct GPU management tooling. Hands-on reports also show production LLM serving with custom kernels on 8×MI355X, so workloads clearly ship on this part. However, no evidence item shows ROCm/HIP documentation explicitly naming MI355X (or gfx950/CDNA 4) as a supported target. Missing for 10: an explicit ROCm compatibility-matrix or supported-GPU listing naming MI355X, and first-party docs tying specific ROCm versions to this part.
